coverage.note: November 2 archives contain 66 current mail counties and 65 current early-voting counties. Levy mail and Leon/Levy early uploads are unavailable. District tables explicitly retain their verified October 30 county records, so this is a mixed-date district snapshot. Current archive county-party counts reconcile to official statistics; the official public compilation separately carries November 1 aggregates for the missing methods. These are different dated sources and are not forced to agree. 44 mail county originals were separately downloaded and checked against the archive; remaining county sources are archive extractions, not separately downloaded originals. FL-27 and FL-28 have current mail and early source coverage.

definitions.provided: VoteByMail status P (provided, not yet returned).
definitions.returnRate: Returned divided by sent/provided universe (V ÷ (P + V)).
definitions.early: Reported early in-person ballots from separate EVL county originals
definitions.cast: Unique recorded voters across returned VBM and early voting; same-person cross-method records counted once. Reported method counts remain unadjusted and reconcile to official sources.
